strings.zh: 我们老大正在里面跟客人谈生意,{NEWLINE}任何人不得入内！
strings.en: Our boss is inside talking business{NEWLINE}with a client. Nobody goes in!

strings.zh: 哎哟,好疼……{NEWLINE}我给你让开就是了。
strings.en: Ow, that hurts... Fine,{NEWLINE}I’ll get out of your way.

strings.zh: 我们老大很凶的,{NEWLINE}劝你别进去惹他生气。
strings.en: Our boss is really scary. I wouldn’t go{NEWLINE}in there and make him mad if I were you.
